intent: A cool stone-pale quarryman's set under one hugely wide dark timber carrying yoke bound in rusted iron, with a thick slate goggle band, a dust mask, a wide rope strap and a thigh mallet; at the high camera the pale mass reads as quarried stone, barred by the yoke.
requests: A chalk-dust pale material, matte and flecked, so the stone-pale cloth reads as quarry dust rather than plain fabric under the mood preset.
A carrying-yoke builder (beam, iron hoops and hanging rope ends), so the set's one silhouette object costs fewer parts.
